A modelling review with little plant data; every number is reprinted from vendors (Tenova, Metso Outotec, SMS) or from the Shahabuddin et al. HSC thermodynamic model. Main file: melting-furnace_electric-smelting in five contexts: Tenova iBlue design ranges (SEC 0.5-1.2 MWh/t, gas 0.4-2.0 GJ/t DRI, capacity), Metso Outotec 1.2 Mtpa furnace (capacity), Shahabuddin base case Table 3 (598.2 kWh/t HM derived as 631.13 kWh / 1.055 t hot metal), and the model SEC ranges at MR 90% (706-850, 1300-1600 degC) and MR 100% (572-684, 7-16% gangue). Flows: Table 3 per t hot metal (DRI, lime, electricity, slag, CO) and Tenova slag/metal ratio. Other-values: SEC sensitivities, model conditions, feed tonnages, design power, SAF Joule heat. Not loaded: values only read from Figs 3-4 curves, CFD/arc modelling results (no energy numbers).
